name: zinc and ring finger 3

function.text: ZNRF3 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase ZNRF3. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin-protein transferase activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity. It participates in limb development and protein ubiquitination.
